title.narrative: Strengthening heritage to promote culture as a global public good

description.narrative: In 2024 Brazil will be responsible for the presidency of G20 and 3 of the 4 axes priorities in culture (Cultural diversity and social inclusion; Creative economy and sustainable economic development; and Preservation, safeguarding and promotion of cultural heritage and memory) are in alignment with outputs 5.CLT1 and 5.CLT5 of 42 C/5. So UBO proposal is to take the opportunity to work in alignment with these international priorities in Brazil as a strategy to promote culture as a global public good. In Output 5.CLT1, UBO will: Strengthen the debate about the G20 proposals on the protection of heritage with governmental actors, NGOs and CSOs; Cooperate with governmental and private actors in the organization of events to discuss heritage, climate change and memory, involving historical heritage, tourism and World Heritage sites; and Produce content to disseminate information about cultural programmatic references.
